summary: West Enclave Merger Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 10,000,000 units at $10.00/unit, each consisting of one ordinary share and one right to receive one-tenth of a share post-business combination. Gross proceeds were $100,000,000, with a 45-day underwriter over-allotment option for up to 1,500,000 additional units. Key agreements filed include underwriting (EarlyBirdCapital), rights, letter, trust, registration rights, and private placement purchase agreements. The trust arrangement secures IPO proceeds pending a business combination. Watch for target acquisition announcement within 24 months or risk of liquidation.
